<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A thin strip above the page: an icon, one sentence, a link and an optional close button. Axes: tone (default,
  muted), layout (center, split), dismiss (show, hide).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type AnnouncementBarProps = {
  label: string;
  text: string;
  cta?: string;
  ctaHref?: string;
  icon?: string;
  dismissLabel: string;
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  layout?: "center" | "split";
  dismiss?: "show" | "hide";
  badgeLabel?: string;
  badge?: "none" | "show";
  position?: "top" | "bottom";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  text,
  cta,
  ctaHref,
  icon = "megaphone",
  dismissLabel,
  tone = "default",
  layout = "center",
  dismiss = "hide",
  badgeLabel,
  badge = "none",
  position = "top",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<AnnouncementBarProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="aside"
    :class="cn(
      'w-full',
      (((position as string) === 'bottom') ? 'sticky bottom-0 z-40 border-t border-border' : ''),
      (
        (tone as string) === 'muted' ? 'bg-muted text-foreground'
        : 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
      )
    )"
    :aria-label="(landmarkLabel ?? label)"
    data-testid="announcement"
    :data-layout="layout"
  >
    <Container
      :class="cn(
        'mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4',
        'flex items-center gap-4 py-2',
        (((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'justify-between' : 'justify-center')
      )"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Group
        gap="4"
        align="center"
        :class="cn(
          'min-w-0 flex-wrap',
          ((((layout as string) === 'center') && ((dismiss as string) === 'show')) ? 'ml-auto' : '')
        )"
      >
        <LucideIcon :name="icon" :size="16" />
        <Inline v-if="((badge as string) === 'show')"
          class="rounded px-2 py-0 text-xs font-semibold inset-ring inset-ring-current"
          data-testid="announcement-badge"
        >
          {{ badgeLabel }}
        </Inline>
        <Text size="sm">
          {{ text }}
        </Text>
        <LinkPlain v-if="cta"
          :href="urlOf(ctaHref)"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold underline underline-offset-4"
          data-testid="announcement-cta"
        >
          {{ cta }}
          <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" :size="16" />
        </LinkPlain>
      </Group>
      <Button v-if="((dismiss as string) === 'show')"
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        class="ml-auto shrink-0 text-current"
        type="button"
        :aria-label="dismissLabel"
        data-testid="dismiss"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="x" :size="16" />
      </Button>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
